adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`, which is a case-sensitive comparison. Since input emails can vary in casing (`z.string().email()` doesn’t normalize) and the code does not lowercase `guest` or `attendee.email` (unlike the blacklist normalization), a case-variant of an existing attendee email could pass this check and be added again via `createMany`, resulting in duplicate attendees differing only by case.
